components.name: Secondary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d5ddd8); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #0d1712); font: 680 0.875rem/1.2 var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 200ms, border-color 200ms, transform 200ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #5a6861); background: var(--surface-soft, #edf2ef); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--highlight, #f2c94c); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
weapp.dev looks through an engineering lens: cool, focused, and allergic to ecosystem-portal theatrics. The interface is neutral, technical, and product-led. Real project marks, interactive demos, metrics, and source links do the persuading; decoration stays secondary.

Surfaces stay calm across light and dark themes. A mint-sage canvas carries WeUI-adjacent forest green as the single ecosystem accent, with Signal Amber reserved for focus and selection. Motion is restrained—reveal fades and 200ms state transitions only, and reduced-motion users get an immediate static state.
keyCharacteristics: Emblem-plus-wordmark lockup with a fixed green Hub mark
One accent family, dual-theme surfaces, bilingual Chinese/English parity
Flat tonal layering by default; shadows only for floating chrome
Small radii (6–8px), solid primary actions, 1px press feedback
Evidence-first: demos, metrics, and project marks beat stock illustration

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: WeUI Forest Green is the only brand accent on a screen. Signal Amber is inspection-only (focus/selection), never a second marketing color.

rules.name: The Honest Mark Rule
rules.body: Project logos and the Hub mark stay true to source assets. Do not recolor, glow, or collage platform logos into the Hub mark.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Meta Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for metadata and controls, not paragraphs. If it is a sentence, it is Geist Sans.

rules.name: The Balanced Head Rule
rules.body: Headings use text-wrap: balance; body uses pretty. Do not add letter-spacing tricks to display type.

rules.name: The Single-Target Row Rule
rules.body: Featured projects present as full-width rows with optional reversed demo/copy order. Do not revive the discarded three-column project card board.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Content cards and section blocks stay flat. If it is not floating UI chrome, it does not cast shadow-panel.

rules.name: The Small-Radius Rule
rules.body: Prefer 6–8px. Large squircles and fashion-soft 16–24px radii are out of system.

dos: Do keep Chinese and English surfaces visually paired—same hierarchy, marks, and spacing.
Do ship static-first: default content and demo output readable with JS disabled.
Do use real project marks, metrics, and demos as proof.
Do preserve light/dark token roles rather than inventing a third theme.
Do honor reduced-motion and reduced-transparency by dropping reveal motion and header blur.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand accent or gradient wash across hero/marketing bands.
Don't cast content-card drop shadows; reserve shadow-panel for floating chrome.
Don't recolor the Hub mark or collage platform logos into it.
Don't revive the three-column project card board.
Don't fabricate testimonials, download counts, or sponsor proof in the visual layer.
